Class DamageCardPool

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.card.DamageCard.DamageCardPool
public class DamageCardPool extends Object
Damage Card Pool - Global singleton that manages all damage cards. Unlike personal programming card decks, damage cards are shared resources that are distributed on demand.
